verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at quo.com (HTTP 200) with a Quo product summary, and the docs include a "Build with AI LLMs" page, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented material. The llms.txt entries shown are mostly marketing pages (Google Voice comparison, Canadian numbers, vanity numbers), not API reference, and the docs.md and OpenAPI probes returned 404. Missing for 10: an API-docs-focused llms.txt or markdown docs endpoint, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
